package.name: Finco1 Post-25B Readiness Delta & Next Refresh Cadence

what_phase_25b_improves: Generic Modelling Loop is implemented end-to-end.
Persistence rotation is minimal and scoped.
Exploratory banner is required for generic_solar / generic_wind.
No schema migration, no backfill, no new financial formulas, no model formula changes.
10 KPI delta list is documented and tested.
84 new tests reported green in the PR body.
what_phase_25b_does_not_improve: Generic Solar is not Excel-parity validated against a reference solar model.
Generic Wind is not Excel-parity validated against a reference wind model.
Generic Solar / Wind defaults are not market-validated assumptions.
Paid pilot has not been authorized.
No customer reference has been made.
The What Changed deltas are explanatory, not guaranteed accuracy claims.
The scenario compare is internal functionality, not model validation.
The export / download pack is internal artifact generation, not bankability.
Enterprise SaaS readiness is not claimed.

internal_demo.after_phase_25b: improved (Generic Defaults Prefill Button, 3-way / 4-way Generic Scenario Compare, Multi-Compare Picker, Runtime What Changed Delta Indicator)
internal_demo.net_effect: the internal demo can now show the Generic Modelling / Scenario Loop end-to-end

controlled_generic_pilot.before_phase_25b: not ready (the Generic Modelling Loop was not end-to-end)
controlled_generic_pilot.after_phase_25b: partially ready (the Generic Modelling Loop is end-to-end; the controlled pilot is not yet authorized)
controlled_generic_pilot.net_effect: the controlled pilot is the next step after Phase 25B

paid_pilot.net_effect: the paid pilot is not authorized by Phase 25B. The paid pilot is governed by the B25 / B33 / B35 stop / go checklists and the B45 controlled pilot runbook.

external_review.net_effect: external review is a separate workstream. Phase 25B does not affect the external review.

commercial_claims.before_phase_25b: partially improved but not promoted (per B38)
commercial_claims.after_phase_25b: partially improved (more internal functionality available) but not promoted (no new commercial claim)
commercial_claims.net_effect: the B44 Generic Solar / Wind Exploratory Boundary & Demo Guardrail refreshes the commercial guardrail for the Generic Modelling / Scenario Loop arc

enterprise_saas_readiness.net_effect: the enterprise SaaS readiness dimension is unaffected by Phase 25B. The enterprise SaaS readiness is governed by the B8 / B17 / B25 / B33 artifacts.

hard_stop_conditions: Any code file touched by the refresh.
Any template / static file touched by the refresh.
Any app / services / main_web / main_api / repository / persistence / domain / test / fixture / schema / migrations file touched by the refresh.
Any existing B1-B40 file modified without explicit justification.
Any no-go claim relaxed without explicit governance approval.
Any prohibited no-go claim scenario represented as approved / merged.
Paid pilot authorization claimed without evidence.
External validation / bankability / certification / production-ready / enterprise SaaS-ready claim made.
global_notes: Phase 25B is a UI + minimal metadata-persistence rotation. Phase 25B is not a model validation, not a bankability claim, not a paid pilot authorization, not a production readiness claim, not an enterprise SaaS readiness claim.
The cadence plan is the trigger-and-artifact framework for future B-track governance refreshes. The cadence plan does not pre-authorize future work. The cadence plan is a planning aid.
Claude review / post-51T review are separate workstreams. They are referenced only as review evidence, not external validation or certification.
